catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

society.political_system: Feudal duchies with ruling dukes and barons.
society.origins_of_power: Magneton miners built mining and trading fleets. Control of extraction, ships and trade turned them into the ruling class.

economy.routes: Cities and duchies depend on ships moving between settlements and Magneton mining sites.

society.protection_and_wealth: While Rovan protected merchant and mining ships from pirates, other rulers traded and grew wealthier. His own fleet and resources dwindled.

metals.name: Magneton Type B
metals.ambiguity: The exact division between Type A hull structures and the author-described Type B hull components has not been defined.

metals.name: Magneton Type C
properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types
Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons
metals.availability: Most difficult to find; recently discovered

known_crafting.material_source: Type C taken from the seized Auric Reach Caravan
known_crafting.advantage: The crafted equipment enables the honour guard to drift along magnetic fields and leap between ships.
known_crafting.weapon_vulnerability_status: None established; the author specifies imperviousness to any weapons.

tesla_guns.description: Fictional electrical weapons carried by armoured soldiers.
tesla_guns.visual_design: Copper coils with green-lit charges; no technical construction recipe is established.

characters.name: Rovan Vey
characters.title: Duke
characters.status: A duke in name only at the opening
characters.rise_to_power: Protected other cities and their ships from pirates.
characters.initial_condition: Depleted fleet, few resources, unable to pay his soldiers despite their sacrifices.
characters.motivation: Resents wealthy rulers who benefited from his protection and declares he will define his own future and take what is his.
characters.key_quote: I will define my own future. We sail for Auric Reach. I will take what is mine.

military.recruitment: Funded and equipped from seized resources; veterans drill recruits

characters.exclusive_knowledge: Secret Type C crafting knowledge gained through experience

story_timeline.event: Nuclear war fractures Earth and nearly extinguishes humanity.
Survivors adapt across generations; Magneton emerges from fused nuclear materials.
Magneton power, stabilization, local gravity and transport allow floating cities to grow.
Mining and trade wealth forms the new feudal duchies and barons.
Rovan protects shipping from pirates; other rulers grow rich while his own fleet dwindles.
Rovan and Grievous discuss the city, unpaid soldiers and depleted accounts.
Armoured soldiers board an Auric Reach Caravan with Tesla guns aimed at unarmed sailors. Rovan seizes the ship for unpaid protection fees; his soldiers cheer.
Rovan declares his own future. Seized resources fund recruits and equipment; trained veterans drill the new soldiers. He departs with one capital ship.
He raids an Auric Reach baron, seizes ships and captures a city easily through superior training and surprise.
story_timeline.war_context: First organised inter-duchy war since the Fracture; earlier nuclear war and fighting pirates still occurred.

story_timeline.event: Rovan crafts the stolen silver Type C into exactly five armour-and-sword sets using his exclusive experience and secret.
The five honour guards reveal weapon-impervious armour and magnetic-field drifting for ship-to-ship leaps.
story_timeline.published_visual_interpretation: The first trial shows Tesla fire failing to penetrate the armour.

panels.caption: THE NUCLEAR WAR DID NOT END WITH RUINS.
panels.narration: The Earth itself shattered.
panels.image_description: Fractured landmasses suspended in a glowing magnetic field

panels.caption: CONTINENTS BECAME ISLANDS IN THE VOID.
panels.narration: Turbulent magnetic waves held the fragments together.Violent in motion. Predictable in their patterns.
panels.image_description: Magnetic currents arc between the exposed undersides of floating islands

panels.caption: HUMANITY WAS ALMOST WIPED OUT.
panels.narration: Those who survived learned to liveon the pieces of their old world.
panels.image_description: A small human silhouette standing on a floating island

panels.caption: GENERATIONS PASSED IN THE MAGNETIC FIELDS.
panels.narration: Humanity slowly evolved.New attributes emerged in a changed world.
panels.image_description: Three generations of survivors study a magnetic sensing instrument in their settlement

panels.caption: NUCLEAR MATERIALS FUSED INTO SOMETHING NEW.
panels.narration: A family of metals unlike anything from the old world.
panels.image_description: Luminous Magneton ore embedded in fractured rock

panels.caption: THEY CALLED IT MAGNETON.
panels.narration: What began as a discoverybecame the foundation of civilization.
panels.image_description: Two glowing green Type B Magneton cores of opposite polarity inside a precision motor

panels.caption: OPPOSITE POLARITIES. CONSTANT MOTION.
panels.narration: Oppositely polarized Type B cores drove magnetic motors.The motors powered a new age.
panels.image_description: A floating city built above a glowing Magneton engine

panels.caption: THE ENGINES DID MORE THAN KEEP THE LIGHTS ON.
panels.narration: They stabilized the islands and generateda field that restored the feel of the old gravity.
panels.image_description: People stand upright inside a city gravity-control chamber while fragments float outside

panels.caption: CITIES ROSE ABOVE THE BROKEN EARTH.
panels.narration: Magneton kept them afloat.Every city depended on its supply.
panels.image_description: A market street powered by green conduits beneath the floating city’s towers

panels.caption: THE FIRST BARONS WERE MINERS.
panels.narration: They extracted Magneton and built ships from it.Magnetic motors carried them between the islands.
panels.image_description: A squat Mole mining ship with an ore cassette, drill, and magnetic engines

panels.caption: TRADE ROUTES LED TO CITIES. MINING ROUTES LED TO POWER.
panels.narration: Those who controlled the mines and the fleetsbecame the new ruling class.
panels.image_description: Ore is unloaded at a mining dock as a proprietor oversees trade

panels.caption: THE CITIES GATHERED INTO DUCHIES.
panels.narration: Civilization returned to feudal rule.Its foundations were no longer land alone, but Magneton.
panels.image_description: Mining barons gather in a council chamber overlooking floating cities

panels.caption: VEYMARCH. A DUKE IN NAME.
panels.narration: Duke Rovan Vey overlooks the small city his fleet can barely afford to protect.
panels.image_description: Rovan and his general look over a small island city with battered ships

panels.caption: THE COST OF KEEPING THE ROUTES OPEN.
panels.narration: General Grievous: “The soldiers’ pay is overdue. The repair yards are waiting too.”
panels.image_description: General Grievous presents the fleet accounts and an almost empty pay chest

panels.caption: OTHER DUKES GREW RICH. HIS FLEET GREW SMALLER.
panels.narration: Rovan: “We bled keeping pirates from their mining ships. They traded. They grew. And now I cannot pay the soldiers who made it possible.”
panels.image_description: Duke Rovan Vey turns toward a wealthy Caravan with a decision taking shape

panels.caption: A CARAVAN FROM THE NEARBY DUCHY OF AURIC REACH.
panels.narration: Armoured soldiers board the trading ship. Charged Tesla guns hold the unarmed sailors at a standstill.
panels.image_description: Bronze-armoured soldiers board a twin-hull Caravan and aim Tesla guns at unarmed sailors

panels.caption: THE DUKE PRESENTS HIS CLAIM.
panels.narration: Rovan: “I seize this vessel of Auric Reach against the unpaid protection fees owed to my soldiers.”
panels.image_description: Rovan announces the seizure to the merchant captain while his soldiers guard the sailors

panels.caption: THE SOLDIERS ANSWER WITH A CHEER.
panels.narration: The cheers roll across the deck. The sailors remain silent. Grievous watches both sides.
panels.image_description: Soldiers cheer with their Tesla guns raised safely while the civilian crew stands silent

panels.caption: ROVAN WILL NO LONGER WAIT FOR ANOTHER DUKE’S PERMISSION.
panels.narration: Rovan: “I will define my own future. We sail for Auric Reach. I will take what is mine.”
panels.image_description: Rovan declares his own future at the seized Caravan’s chart table

panels.caption: THE SEIZED RESOURCES BECOME PAY, EQUIPMENT, AND NEW RECRUITS.
panels.narration: His veterans are exceptionally well trained. Now they put that experience into drilling the new soldiers.
panels.image_description: Bronze-armoured veterans train new recruits equipped from seized resources

panels.caption: ONE CAPITAL SHIP. A SMALL FLEET. AN ARMY WITH PURPOSE.
panels.narration: Rovan takes his army toward Auric Reach. His fleet has only one capital ship: a Bastion.
panels.image_description: A single Bastion capital ship departs with the seized merchant Caravan nearby

panels.caption: THE FIRST WAR BETWEEN DUCHIES SINCE THE FRACTURE.
panels.narration: They have fought pirates. They have never faced an organised invasion. Rovan strikes at one of Auric Reach’s barons.
panels.image_description: Rovan’s trained bronze-armoured troops surprise an Auric Reach baron’s docks

panels.caption: THE DOCKS FALL. THE SHIPS ARE SEIZED.
panels.narration: His veterans move with a discipline the defenders cannot match. The baron loses control of the harbour.
panels.image_description: Veteran troops secure captured merchant airships at the baron’s harbour

panels.caption: THEN THE CITY FALLS WITH SURPRISING EASE.
panels.narration: Superior training gives Rovan his victory. The captured city and ships become the foundation of his growing power.
panels.image_description: Rovan receives the surrender of the captured city alongside disciplined troops

panels.caption: THE CARAVAN CARRIED SOMETHING RARER THAN WEALTH.
panels.narration: Silvery Type C Magneton. From his own experience, Rovan alone knows the secret of crafting it into armour and swords.
panels.image_description: Rovan privately forges silver Type C taken from the seized Caravan

panels.caption: FIVE SUITS OF ARMOUR. FIVE SWORDS. NO METAL FOR A SIXTH SET.
panels.narration: He equips five members of his honour guard. Their silver Type C armour is impenetrable and impervious to weapons.
panels.image_description: Exactly five honour guards stand together in silver Type C armour, each carrying a sword

panels.caption: THE SILVER GUARD CAN DRIFT ALONG THE MAGNETIC FIELDS.
panels.narration: In their first trial, Tesla fire cannot pierce the silver. They drift from ship to ship across the void—an advantage no rival possesses.
panels.image_description: Silver honour guards drift along magnetic fields between airships while weapons fail to penetrate their armour

terms.Magneton: Family of metals formed from nuclear materials after the Fracture.
terms.Duchy: Grouping of floating cities within the new feudal order.
terms.Baron: A ruler whose power grew from Magneton extraction, ships and trade.
terms.Capital ship: The rarest and most expensive military airship class.
terms.Magnetic motor: An engine using opposing polarities in city and transport systems.

canon_constraints: There is one available story entry, Prologue, with nine pages and 27 distinct panel images.
Rovan begins the campaign with exactly one capital ship; the seized Caravan is a merchant vessel.
The first city capture precedes the crafting of silver honour-guard equipment.
There are exactly five complete Type C armour-and-sword sets and no material for a sixth.
Type C is impervious to any weapons; no weapon vulnerability or armour-piercing exception is established.
Only Rovan knows the crafting secret through his experience.
